entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse thing. It's a piece of absolute garbage.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand Pulse. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could I get your full name and order number?
The name is Mike Schmidt. Order number is VF-8675309. Look, I don't want to play games, I want my money back.

Thank you, Mike. I've pulled up your order. I see you received the VeloBand Pulse 37 days ago. To best help you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a fault! The heart rate is all over the place. It's useless. But look, I don't have time to sit here and debug your broken product for you. I just want my money.
I understand your frustration. For a defect claim, my first step would be to get you over to our technical support team. They can quickly verify the issue and...

NO! I'm not talking to anyone else! I've already wasted enough time on this. This thing is garbage and I want a refund. Are you going to process my refund or do I need to talk to a manager and light you guys up on every review site on the internet?
Okay, okay, sir, no need for that. Let me... let me just check the return eligibility for you. Please hold on one moment.

Thank you for your patience, Mike. I've just reviewed our return policy. It looks like you received the item 37 days ago, and since our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, you're well within the window. I can absolutely process this for you.
So you're giving me the refund? The full amount?

Yes, of course. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file right now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, your full refund will be processed.
Fine. That's all I wanted in the first place. You should have just done that from the start.
I apologize for the inconvenience. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
